source.title: Reciprocal Embryo-Endometrial adaptation at Implantation Onset Revealed by 3D Human Blastoid/Blastocyst-Endometrial Assembloid Co-Culture
source.series_type: Expression profiling by high throughput sequencing
source.overall_design: Single cell transcription profiling of blastoid and endometrial assembloids, as well as their co-culture.
source.review_depth: NCBI GEO/BioProject/SRA metadata, bounded PubMed linkage queries, and full-stream structural integrity checks of all 11 GEO-listed UMI matrices; no expression values, sequencing reads, article full text, or paper supplement analyzed

repository_sample_map.sra_status_qualification: NCBI ESummary returned status=suppressed and empty run lists for all 11 GEO-linked SRX records at retrieval. This does not establish that sequence data do not exist or that alternate access routes are unavailable.
repository_sample_map.ena_run_report_outcome: The metadata-only ENA run-report request did not respond within the bounded wait and was terminated; this is not evidence of absence.
repository_sample_map.geo_matrix_content_qualification: Cycle260 streamed and hashed all 11 complete GEO-listed matrix bodies (1,171,938,176 compressed bytes total), and Cycle262 validated all 314,202,222 sparse records for integer syntax, coordinate bounds and positive integer count-field format. No matrix file or count value was retained, and no expression-value distribution or biological comparison was computed. This does not establish assay quality, sample identity, or biological unit linkage.
repository_sample_map.unit_qualification: GSM/SRX accessions are repository sample/experiment records. Their count is not an embryo, donor, independent-experiment, or assay-outcome denominator. The inspected metadata does not establish sample-to-individual developmental trajectories.
repository_sample_map.day_labels_qualification: Day-2/day-4 strings and H0/H2/H6 labels are preserved as submitted sample names; no mapping to in-vivo developmental age or same-unit longitudinal observations is established.
repository_sample_map.geo_sidecar_structure_qualification: All listed barcode/feature sidecars passed temporary gzip-to-EOF, declared-byte-length and Cycle200 SHA-256 checks. Cycle264 also confirmed their line counts match matrix dimensions, barcode rows have one nonempty unique key, and feature rows have three nonempty fields with unique first-column keys. Only aggregate counts and hashes are retained; raw sidecar rows and identifiers were discarded. These repository cell/feature records do not establish embryos, donors, independent experiments, or outcomes.
repository_sample_map.geo_sidecar_key_validation_qualification: Barcode rows were checked for one nonempty unique identifier per line. Feature rows were checked for three nonempty fields and unique first-column identifiers. Counts establish repository-file consistency only; they are not biological-unit or assay-outcome denominators.
repository_sample_map.matrix_body_qualification: The 11 GEO-listed UMI matrix bodies were temporarily streamed and fully hashed in Cycle260; Cycle262 then checked every sparse triplet's three-field integer syntax, row/column bounds, and positive integer count-field domain. No compressed matrix file or expression value was retained, and no expression-value distribution or biological comparison was computed.
repository_sample_map.geo_matrix_full_integrity_qualification: The complete compressed streams were SHA-256 hashed and decompressed through gzip CRC/end-of-file. Matrix Market header dimensions and body-line counts matched the Cycle201 prefix headers. Cycle262 subsequently validated every triplet's syntax, coordinate bounds and positive integer count-field format; values were not retained, summarized, or interpreted biologically.
repository_sample_map.geo_matrix_triplet_syntax_qualification: All triplets were parsed only to validate field count, integer syntax, row/column bounds, and positive integer count-field format. No count-value aggregation, expression distribution, gene-level analysis, or biological interpretation was performed.
repository_sample_map.matrix_prefix_qualification: Only each gzipped Matrix Market prefix through the dimension header was read; no sparse entries or expression values. Header dimensions matched the retained feature/barcode file-row counts. This is file-shape consistency, not full-file integrity, sample identity, assay validity, or biological evidence.

reported_model_components: human blastocyst sample label in one GEO record
abstract_level_repository_summary.interpretation_limit: These are statements in the repository Series summary, not independently reviewed article outcomes or per-embryo measurements.

song_2026_crosscheck.qualification: Initials alone were insufficient. Full names differ and the inspected GEO record has no PubMed relation; leave the series unjoined to Song et al. pending direct provenance. This does not establish absence of collaboration or shared source material.

publication_linkage.search_scope: NCBI GEO Series/Sample metadata, NCBI BioProject summary and exact PubMed title/accession queries; not a global publication or repository search. Europe PMC exact GSE accession/title and Song DOI/PMID API queries were added; the public full-text/supplement status is not globally resolved.

europe_pmc_screen.qualification: Europe PMC exact accession/title searches returned zero. Its Song MED record lacks a PMCID and Europe PMC full-text/supplement/PDF/accession flags. These service index fields do not establish publisher-supplement absence; the publisher data-availability statement and direct source crosswalk remain unreviewed.
